task: Make a one-minute Tamil audio summary of this chapter

plan:
1) inspect_media on the provided PDF to confirm it is readable and count pages.
2) ocr_document on the PDF pages to extract chapter text into Markdown.
3) read_text_file on the OCR Markdown to gather the main content for summarization.
4) write_english_text to create an English summary aiming for ~130 words (about 1 minute of speech).
5) translate_text to translate that summary into Tamil (native script).
6) verify_translation to ensure the translation output is structurally consistent.
7) list_voices for Tamil and pick a female voice (or default if needed), then synthesize_speech for the Tamil text.
8) verify_audio by transcribing the synthesized audio and comparing against the Tamil text.
9) finish with the Tamil audio deliverable path.
assumptions: The chapter.pdf is short (2 pages) so OCR + translation + TTS will fit within the Rs 20 budget.
A one-minute Tamil summary corresponds to about ~120–140 Tamil words, produced from a ~130-word English summary.
rationale: I will first inspect the PDF, OCR it to extract the chapter text, then write an English 1-minute summary, translate it to Tamil, synthesize Tamil speech, and finally verify the speech.
I will inspect the PDF to confirm its page count and type before OCR.
I will OCR the PDF to extract its chapter text for summarization.
